name: inspect_ui
description: Extracts a compact semantic accessibility tree (50-100 tokens) using Windows UI Automation. Yields exact control roles, names, and bounding boxes.

max_depth.description: Tree traversal depth limit (default 4 keeps output token-efficient).

max_elements.description: Maximum number of interactive controls to return.

target.description: Optional window title substring (e.g. 'Notepad'). Defaults to foreground/active window.
